correctness.rationale: Exact all-size identity P_n=tr(M^n), where M is 256-by-256 on ordered pairs of two-time 4-bit columns and local majority constraints. Its six live SCCs and each characteristic polynomial are checked by exact integer symbolic computation from a standalone program. Fixed points are classified by forced mixed columns or no-isolated-run pure columns with a four-state transfer. Direct, independently implemented full-state enumeration at n=3..10 matches every formula. Roots and six-residue traces are reconstructed from displayed factors, not inferred from finite samples.

value.rationale: Gives a complete exact recurrent-attractor census for the natural cyclic cubic prism family for every size, not an arbitrary finite slice. The unexpectedly simple residue-six Lucas law proves exponentially different counts of fixed versus oscillating recurrent states and supports quantitative comparisons of recurrent diversity under topology. The factorization reduces a 256-state transfer to six small cyclic blocks, providing a reproducible exact structural characterization. No wider theorem is claimed.
